## How I checked it

- [ ] `swift build` passes
- [ ] `swift test` passes (there is no hosted CI; say what you ran)
- [ ] Screenshots in light and dark mode, for a change you can see in the app
- [ ] Before and after eval numbers, for a cleanup or recognition change (Evals/README.md)
- [ ] No real dictations, recordings or personal data in tests, fixtures or this description

## Contributor licence agreement

CLA Assistant checks every pull request ("license/cla"). If you have not signed yet, follow the link
in its comment. CONTRIBUTING.md explains the agreement and how to sign.
